summary: Pass 29 closes numeric Evil-Point reputation transitions and executable MAXEPDAY/EPCYCLE/EPAMOUNT defaults, wires reputation recalculation to EP mutations, and preserves the Villain/Fiend enforcement-source conflict as unresolved.

facts.claim: MajorMUD reference points are Saint -220..-201, Good -200..-51, Neutral -50..29, Seedy 30..39, Outlaw 40..79, Criminal 80..119, Villain 120..209, and Fiend from 210; the 300-EP attack-initiation lockout is separate and does not introduce a new reputation.
evidence: Archived MajorMUD legal-system documentation mirrored at https://www.mudinfo.net/viewtopic.php?t=2509
operator-corroboration.omnimud-classic.2026-08-27: EP 237 displayed FIEND and 28 to Villain
facts.boundary: The reference table names -220 as the Saint floor but no lower reputation name. Runtime therefore does not invent a ninth band below Saint.

facts.claim: Default MAXEPDAY=18, EPCYCLE=60 minutes and EPAMOUNT=1 are directly retained in WCCMMUD setup/message evidence; the archived MajorMUD documentation supplies the cleanup arithmetic and confirms that forgiveness reduces EP toward Good/Saint.
facts.correction: Prior generated authority stored maximum_daily_reduction as descriptive text, which decoded as zero and was replaced by int.MaxValue. Pass 29 makes the native default executable as integer 18.

facts.claim: At 237 EP OmniMUD Classic displays FIEND, 28 EP to Villain, 1 EP per 60 minutes and max 18/day. This confirms direction and matching evil-side cutoffs/default cycle values but is not treated as native MajorMUD proof or as proof of the complete cleanup schedule.
Native player help and archived operator documentation disagree on whether Villain adds divine intervention or bounty-hunter pursuit and where divine lightning begins.
facts.boundary: No new bounty-hunter/divine enforcement actor is activated until target-version native runtime behavior resolves the conflict.
